title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 114 ]

blocks.text: Social change for the better happens when groups of citizens try to bring it about. Today, such groups can take on many tasks once performed by governments. These so-called non-governmental organizations deliver social services. They are active in various areas from law to medicine. They watch and influence what governments do at home or abroad. What is more, they often work better than governments. This is because they are able to use people from all walks of life.

readingSentences.english: Social change for the better happens when groups of citizens try to bring it about.
readingSentences.korean: 사회가 더 나은 쪽으로 바뀌는 것은 시민들이 모여 그런 변화를 이루려고 노력할 때이다.

readingSentences.english: Today, such groups can take on many tasks once performed by governments.
readingSentences.korean: 오늘날, 그런 단체들이 한때 정부가 행했던 많은 일을 떠맡을 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: These so-called non-governmental organizations deliver social services.
readingSentences.korean: 소위 이런 비정부 조직들이 사회 서비스를 제공한다.

readingSentences.english: They are active in various areas from law to medicine.
readingSentences.korean: 그들은 법률에서 의료에 이르기까지 다양한 분야에서 활동하고 있다.

readingSentences.english: They watch and influence what governments do at home or abroad.
readingSentences.korean: 그들은 정부가 국내외에서 하는 일을 감시하고 영향력을 행사한다.

readingSentences.english: What is more, they often work better than governments.
readingSentences.korean: 게다가, 그들은 흔히 정부보다 일을 더 잘 수행한다.

readingSentences.english: This is because they are able to use people from all walks of life.
readingSentences.korean: 그들은 각계각층의 사람들을 활용할 수 있기 때문이다.
